newsitem.title: INDIA: India's HDFC Bank in 5-yr dlr/rupee swap.
newsitem.headline: India's HDFC Bank in 5-yr dlr/rupee swap.

text.p: India's private HDFC Bank Ltd said on Friday it recently struck the country's first five-year dollar-rupee swap deal for a local firm.
"We have entered into a long-term swap of five-year duration for about $17 million," a bank official told Reuters.
"The Reserve Bank of India has confirmed to us it is the first such deal in India," he said.
Foreign exchange dealers said after liberalisation of the foreign exchange regime, there has been a handful of swap deals for durations upto three years.
The market is still in its infancy because of lack of a term money market in India.
The bank did not want to identify the Indian firm now, the official said.
